description.value: At 4th level, the engineer gains Field Repair as a bonus feat, even if he does not meet the feat's prerequisites. In addition, the engineer can make temporary repairs to broken technology on the fly. Jury-rigging a broken object has a Craft DC equal to the Disable Device DC to disable a device of the same complexity, and requires the same amount of time. If the check is successful, the object is relieved of the broken condition for up to 5 minutes. If a jury-rigged object takes any damage, it regains the broken condition. A jury-rigged object cannot benefit from this ability again until it has been repaired.
